341.blurb: Almost no hopper: a triple-roller slapdown lifts FUEL onto a single-layer tray under the turret table, where three spinning 6in omni wheels serialize it into the uptake to the turret. Shoots as fast as it intakes. Climbs Level 1.

581.blurb: Hopper Division finalist. Rebuilt mid-season from a turret into a dumper: a linear intake slides out on titanium racks and carries the front of the hopper with it, a roller floor that pivots up to compact the load (ramps on the intake lift it as it comes in) feeds a drum at the back, and an adjustable hood throws FUEL out over the back. Fits under the TRENCH, full or not.

604.blurb: Pinnacles winner, Half Moon Bay finalist and 4th seed in the Newton Division (the Autonomous Award). One driver, fully automated scoring: a turret that shoots on the move from anywhere in its zone and feeds from outside it, fed single file by its "Dynamic Point of Capture" serializer, a dye rotor whose hook sweeps FUEL round a plywood bucket to omni wheels that push them up a ramp into a corrugated plastic tube to the turret. A full-width intake on independent polycarbonate arms pushes the sliding hopper out. Goes over the BUMPS (too tall for the TRENCH).

971.blurb: Two independently aimed turrets fed by a roller floor and a powered separator that splits FUEL into two streams. The hopper is pushed out by its 4-bar intake, and a net holds the load in over the top. Climbs Level 1.

1114.blurb: Archimedes Division finalist, 10-0 in qualifications, and Ontario champion. A tall clear hopper box slides out over the intake on racks, under a red "magic blanket" top cover (after 1124's 2008 claw). A roller floor feeds a ball elevator up the tower at the back to a hooded flywheel that fires forward over the hopper. Too tall for the TRENCH, it goes over the BUMPS.

stats.Shot rate: ~14 BPS a full box, ~21 best second (physical)

1678.blurb: Milstein Division champion. A full-width drum with three hood rollers fires out the back, fed by a roller floor and ball tunnel. The hopper grows out with the intake and up with the climber, with a net stretched diagonally over the extension. Climbs Level 1.

1690.blurb: A compact gear-driven turret on an 8in bearing shoots on the move while the intake keeps running. A roller floor pushes FUEL back into two belts along the back, which carry them to flex wheels that kick them up into the turret, where a 4in wheel throws them out against wheels on its hood, geared to it. The intake slides out with the hopper's lattice front, under a thin polycarbonate top that bows up over a full load.

1706.blurb: Seeing double: two spindexers side by side under a deep hopper, each feeding its own turret. The intake folds up inside the hopper and pushes it out as it deploys, and a net over the top stretches as the load grows. 45-2 in 2026.

2056.blurb: A turret on an 8in bearing that shoots on the move and passes from anywhere. A roller floor under a net carries FUEL back to two belts along the back, which run them into a quarter pipe and up between two Stealth wheels into the turret, where a 4in urethane wheel throws them against a backspin kicker on the hood's arm. The two-roller intake slides out on polycarbonate racks.

2910.blurb: Huge hopper and a 4-wide drum shooter fixed to the chassis — the whole robot rotates to aim. Unloads about 25 FUEL per second (30 in short volleys).

3928.blurb: A 5-spoke spindexer with a cone in the middle turns the load round to a tower in the back corner, which lifts FUEL single file to a turret on top. Tall walls and a slide-out intake box make a deep hopper. Too tall for the TRENCH, it goes over the BUMPS.

4414.blurb: Extending hopper holds about 88 FUEL under a stretchy net. A Dye Rotor single-streams FUEL into a turret shooter (about 14 FUEL per second) with precomputed shoot-on-the-move.

4930.blurb: Three hooded flywheel shooters side by side, fixed to the chassis and firing forward over the intake: the robot drives at the HUB to aim. A belt floor carries FUEL back to an updexer that lifts it into all three. Too tall for the TRENCH, it goes over the BUMPS.

4946.blurb: A round robot: a 35in hopper around a turret on the center of rotation, fed by a Dye Rotor tray. Its intake slides out with a net stretched from the hopper down to it. Too tall for the TRENCH, it goes over the BUMPS.

6328.blurb: Full-width drum launcher: a slap-down single-roller intake pulls the hopper's front out with it on a pin and slot, a nine-roller floor (their "Superdexer") feeds two kickers up into a 4in drum under a carbon-fiber hood, throwing FUEL out over the back. The robot turns to aim and launches on the move; while it launches the intake comes slowly back up, sweeping the load toward the launcher. A net over the hopper flexes up as it fills. Fits under the TRENCH.

7769.blurb: Michigan champion and Einstein alliance member, third in the world by EPA. A linear intake slides out on polycarbonate racks, pulling the hopper's front with it; ten timing belts carry FUEL back to a static ramp where compliant and vectored wheels roll them, two abreast, into a 16.5in-wide shooter: two stacks of 4in Stealth wheels flinging them out the back under a static hood. The intake shuffles in and out while it shoots (their "Truffle Shuffle"). Fits under the TRENCH.

8793.blurb: No hopper: a 4-wide intake feeds a conveyor that funnels FUEL to single file, up through the turret and out a hooded flywheel. Holds only what fits in the ball path — intake and shoot at the same time.

best.name: Best for this robot
best.desc: The team's own AUTO where their code is public (8793, 2910, 1678, 604, 1114, 581: from the side it starts on), otherwise the highest-scoring AUTO found for the robot (its own start position, NEUTRAL ZONE sweeps and DEPOT runs), or else the preload and a NEUTRAL ZONE sweep.

preload.name: Score preload
preload.desc: Spin up and shoot the preloaded FUEL from the start line.

depot.name: Preload + Depot
depot.desc: Shoot the preload, collect the 24 FUEL in the DEPOT, drive back and shoot.

sweep.name: Neutral Zone sweep
sweep.desc: Through the TRENCH to the NEUTRAL ZONE, sweep the FUEL line, return over the BUMP shooting on the move.

sweep2.name: Double sweep
sweep2.desc: Two NEUTRAL ZONE sweeps (2910-style), shooting on the move each time back in the ALLIANCE ZONE.

climb.name: Preload + Climb L1
climb.desc: Shoot the preload then climb LEVEL 1 for 15 points (needs a climber add-on).

defendStage.name: Preload + defensive position
defendStage.desc: Shoot the preload, then drive over the BUMP to the middle of the field (own side of the CENTER LINE) to start TELEOP on defense.
